spans.s: voḍī, voḍrī (EI 23), (1/4) paṇa; 20 cowrie-shells; cf. kapardaka-voḍī, ‘voḍī counted in cowrie-shells’.
voḍī , also called voḍikā and voḍrī; sometimes regarded as a cowrie-shell used as coin; but really, the unit equal to 5 gaṇḍās = 20 cowries. Cf. bud̤ī, kapardaka-voḍī (q. v.).
voḍikā , same as voḍī. Cf. bud̤ī and kapardaka-voḍī (q. v.).
